conditions.runtime: Direct authorized same-dimension player chat /tp or /teleport with coordinates and only the sender as target.

change.summary: Prepare destination chunks without blocking the logical server tick.

modifiers.before: Vanilla directly teleports and can block in getChunkBlocking.
modifiers.after: Queue a bounded set of FULL tickets, poll loaded chunks on server tick end and finish on the server thread once the complete destination footprint is available.

rationale.purpose: Allow server ticks to continue during a cold teleport and avoid blocking collision reads.
rationale.decision_source: User approved nonblocking teleport as part of exploration performance work.

introduced.summary: Prepare destination chunks without blocking the logical server tick.

history.summary: Prepare destination chunks without blocking the logical server tick.

relations: Player command -> Forge permission and teleport event -> FULL destination tickets -> server-authoritative arrival
notes: Queue preserves native command coordinates and existing event protections, releases tickets on completion or cancellation and times out after two minutes.
unresolved: Runtime acceptance and measured generation time are pending.
